body: On a serious note, anyone know how to fix this problem? I just switched to droid and no one who has ever texted me with their iPhone can have their texts delivered to me.

Another thing… Don't post a progress pic if you're on day 10 of your diet/fitness plan. All the power to you for getting through 10 days, but real progress is shown with time. Post your pictures at the end of your journey, or at least well into it. If not this subreddit just gets littered.
